name: PIKKO — Yum or Bleah!
pitch: Drag the healthier of two foods to Pikko, a vinyl-toy creature that grimaces and dodges junk: fill his belly with healthy kcal over 40 rounds and discover foods from 24 countries.
community: PIKKO (24 country-bag tokens, pre-launch) with a PASTA pass
access: Free reviewer demo at the play URL: the starter bag and a 5-round trial of every bag need no wallet or tokens; kid mode (default) hides all crypto UI. Interim pass on Solana mainnet: ONE active DevFridge lock of at least 5,000,000 PASTA (5000000000000 raw, 6 decimals) by the connected Phantom wallet unlocks all 24 country bags. Mint 39kMeX4HVRW9qbbiHSPbRQ9xeXUF18GrNP6gL61Ppump (Token-2022, no mint or freeze authority, read-only RPC check 2026-10-04), program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6. Aggregation: single (one lock must reach the minimum; several small locks do not add up). No minimum original or remaining duration; unlockAt must be in the future. Evidence older than 90 s, malformed or failed responses mean unavailable, never unlocked; rechecked every 60 s and before each play. Country tokens are pre-launch fixtures (mint null, shown as not configured); a bag will open with the pass or with its own verified token. The game only reads locks through scan.devfridge.cool and never asks for a signature or transaction; locks are made on DevFridge: no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee buys and burns PASTA (direct burn for PASTA vaults) plus network costs; other tokens need an executable Jupiter route. Browser-side check only: no server authentication, content not protected.
limitations: No recorded gameplay video yet: demoUrl is the live free game (the first Play opens a tutorial with two guided practice rounds). Scores, bests and the recipe book are local to the browser; no server, ranking, rewards or anti-cheat. Verified: 74 unit tests (access boundaries incl. exactly 5,000,000 PASTA, one raw unit less, two smaller locks, expired, stale, foreign depositor, HTTP errors), type check, build, scripted desktop-Chrome playthroughs in 8 languages and tutorial walkthroughs, access UI with a MOCK Phantom and MOCK DevFridge responses. NOT verified: real phones, touch hardware, Safari/Firefox, real Phantom (desktop or mobile), any real lock, redemption or mainnet transaction, wallet-rejection recovery, screen-lock audio resume, nutritionist review of kcal and health copy. 17 of 20 languages are unreviewed machine translations; recorded voices exist only in EN/IT/PL. Food models are procedural placeholders. Most audio cues (owner-generated with Gemini music and ElevenLabs) are unapproved candidates whose commercial-use terms the owner must still confirm. Code and art were AI-built with Claude Code (see BUILD_LOG.md). No licence file yet (all rights reserved). Country tokens and final thresholds are not launched. Three.js MIT. Gallery review does not establish competition eligibility.
